bagPolicy.summary: At UNC athletics events, clear plastic or vinyl bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small clutches up to 4.5" x 6.5" are allowed.
allowed: Clear plastic or vinyl bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"

bagPolicy.note: Necessary medical items are allowed after inspection. Phones, binoculars and cameras can be carried in if they are not in a bag or case. This is the UNC Athletics policy for the Smith Center.
